variants.title: Building a solid foundation
variants.detail: Simple basics are better than fancy ingredients. Apply ceramide and cica cream generously to give your skin barrier time to naturally recover.

variants.title: Strength that builds quietly
variants.detail: Even without visible changes, every day like today is making a real difference. Let ceramide and cica cream reinforce your skin's protective barrier.

variants.title: A day to protect what you have
variants.detail: Rather than adding more, let's protect what you've already built. Wrap your barrier in ceramide and cica for comfort.

defense_toning.caution: Tone refinement with vitamin C and niacinamide · Use only this ingredient during this phase.

variants.title: Quiet refinement
variants.detail: Change may not be obvious, but days like today are what truly matter. Let vitamin C and niacinamide gently refine your tone, finishing with hydration for peace.

variants.title: Gently evening your skin
variants.detail: Take your time with vitamin C and niacinamide to balance tone and oil. Finish with hydration.

variants.title: Clarity comes slowly
variants.detail: Today's focus is on tone refinement. Apply vitamin C and niacinamide lightly, then finish with hydration.

variants.title: Little by little becomes change
variants.detail: Day after day of the same routine builds trust with your skin. Let hyaluronic acid fill your skin with moisture from within, then gently layer to keep it comfortable.

variants.title: Comfort through hydration
variants.detail: Today we focus on hydration. Layer hyaluronic acid gently along skin texture to create a comfortable, plump feeling.

variants.title: Hydration from within
variants.detail: The foundation comes first. Let hyaluronic acid hydrate from deep within so your skin can find its own balance.

barrier_lock.caution: Ceramide alone · Use only this ingredient during this phase.

variants.title: Sealing in what you've built
variants.detail: After hydrating with hyaluronic acid, seal it in with ceramide cream so your skin doesn't lose that moisture.

toning_solo.caution: Vitamin C alone · Use only this ingredient during this phase.

variants.title: Focusing on tone today
variants.detail: Today is all about tone with vitamin C. Apply gently along your skin texture to brighten and refine.

sos_rest.caution: Cica for calm and reset · Use only this ingredient during this phase.

variants.detail: Take a break from everything else. Just cica is enough to give your skin the recovery time it needs.

concern_purchase_guide.nia: Looking for niacinamide? Search '2-5% niacinamide serum' on your favorite shopping site—it's gentle and easy to start with.
concern_purchase_guide.hya: Looking for hyaluronic acid? Search 'hyaluronic acid ampoule or serum' online. Mixed-weight molecules matter more than high concentration.
concern_purchase_guide.cica: Looking for cica? Search 'cica' or 'centella asiatica' online. Cream formulas give longer-lasting calm.
concern_purchase_guide.cer: Looking for ceramide? Search 'ceramide cream' online. Look for 'ceramide complex' or 'barrier cream' labels for safety.

completion.title: You completed the barrier reset course
completion.detail_template: Your {{totalDays}}-day record shows how your barrier has changed. Thank you for staying with us. Check below if you'd like to explore the next phase.

bha.title: BHA Exfoliation Day
bha.guide: After cleansing, saturate a cotton pad with BHA toner. Focus on your T-zone and pores, gently wiping in light strokes. Follow with a hydrating cream to balance moisture.
bha.caution: Active exfoliation day for pores · Next morning, sunscreen is essential

retinol.title: Retinol Introduction Day
retinol.guide: After evening cleanse, mix just half a rice grain of retinol into your regular hydrating cream. Go slow—this is an introduction.
steps: Mix retinol (rice grain amount) into hydrating cream
retinol.caution: Renewal support day · Morning sunscreen is essential · Tomorrow, rest with barrier and hydration focus

defense_barrier.title: Barrier Strengthening Day
defense_barrier.guide: After gentle cleanse, apply ceramide and cica-rich cream generously. Let your barrier rebuild naturally—this is rest time for your skin.
defense_barrier.caution: Ceramide + cica for barrier support · Use only this ingredient during this phase.

defense_toning.title: Tone Refinement Day
defense_toning.guide: Cleanse, then use vitamin C and niacinamide to gently balance tone and oil. Finish with light hydration.
steps: Apply vitamin C · niacinamide toner or serum
defense_toning.caution: Vitamin C + niacinamide for tone · Use only this ingredient during this phase.

defense_hydration.title: Hydration Boost Day
defense_hydration.guide: Use hyaluronic acid to fill your skin with moisture from within. Apply in thin layers along your skin texture for lasting comfort.
defense_hydration.caution: Hyaluronic acid for deep moisture · Use only this ingredient during this phase.

barrier_lock.title: Barrier Seal Day
barrier_lock.guide: Use ceramide cream alone today—focus on sealing and strengthening. No other actives, just protection.
barrier_lock.caution: Ceramide alone · Use only this ingredient during this phase.

hydration_lock.title: Hydration Lock Day
hydration_lock.guide: First, hydrate with hyaluronic acid. Then seal everything in with ceramide cream so moisture can't escape.
hydration_lock.caution: Hyaluronic acid + ceramide · Use only these ingredients during this phase.

toning_solo.title: Vitamin C Day
toning_solo.guide: Use vitamin C alone to brighten and refine tone. Apply gently along your skin texture, then finish with hydration.
toning_solo.caution: Vitamin C alone · Use only this ingredient during this phase.

sos_rest.title: Skin Calm Day
sos_rest.guide: Give your skin a break. Use only cica to soothe and reset. Skip other actives—just gentle care today.
sos_rest.caution: Cica for calm and reset · Use only this ingredient during this phase.
